content.text:
The ribbon buttons now stand out clearly from the body, and group headers run the body's full height with no padding above or below.

**Why the old buttons were so faint:** gpui-kit keeps only about a fifth of a custom button's resting colour. The dark buttons came out at 73 on a 68 body instead of the intended 92. Hover and pressed colours weren't affected. I now set the resting colour on the button directly (`src/ribbon/mod.rs`).

**New contrast**, measured in pictures of the ribbon:

| | Body | Button | Hover | Pressed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dark mode | 68 | 94 (white 14%) | white 22% | black 20% |
| Light mode | 208 | about 227 (white 45%) | white 70% | black 12% |

Both are still grey-on-grey, just visible now. Light mode first came out at 241, which looked much stronger than dark, so I eased it to 45%. The colours are laid over the body, so they still work on the tinted Code and Spec bodies.

**Headers:**
- **Title strips:** they now run the full 98px body height.
- **Padding:** the body keeps 8px only on its left and right; the 8px above and below now goes around the buttons.
- **Gaps:** buttons stay 82px tall and 8px apart, and each strip is 8px from its buttons.

**Checked:**
- **`ribbon_buttons_are_full_or_slim_and_square`:** checks in both modes that:
  - the groups reach the body's top and bottom;
  - the buttons are padded 8px above and below;
  - each button's lightness differs clearly but modestly from the body (6–16% of the scale).

  I confirmed it fails with the old faint colour.
- **Stacking test:** updated for the full-height groups.
- **Everything else:** all 195 tests pass (1 ignored), the release build has no warnings, and `piton check`, `piton build check` and `piton build` pass.

**Spec:** the Ribbon scope now describes the stronger button contrast, the full-height title strips, and where the padding sits.
